candidates.title: [RFC]: Simulated execution with pluggable timing models (building on #47922)
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  #47922 (`--simulate-forward`, by @sagearc) runs vLLM's real scheduler and KV-cache manager without a forward pass: the model is built on the meta device, KV blocks are virtual, and output tokens come from #46701 trace replay. This RFC proposes to build on it by adding **time**. Each simulated step would take the time a pluggable timing model predicts. candidates.title: [RFC] Monokernel framework for SGLang
candidates.snippet: This RFC adds one framework for monokernels in SGLang. Each model supplies a spec and its kernels. The framework supplies the switch, the checks, the routing, the safety rules, and the CI gate.  ## Motivation  A monokernel is a persistent kernel that runs most of a decoder layer, including the tensor-parallel all-reduce, in one or two launches.
